answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by anchoring each identity to a provenance ledger where a lotus-sealed genesis record is co-signed by independent peers, making forged duplicates detectable through archival cross-reference. Every new agent must submit a verifiable chain-of-custody whose echo is checked against prior willow-attested registrations, so colluding replicas. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
